definition: Alpha-mannosidosis is a rare inherited metabolic disorder caused by reduced activity of a lysosomal form of alpha-mannosidase, leading to buildup of mannose-rich substances in cells. In psychological or cognitive context, it is notable because affected people are described as having psychomotor retardation.

provenance.scope: Source record D008363; pinned source text

reasons: “Rare” is not supported by the supplied packet.
The phrase “in psychological or cognitive context” is not needed to define the term itself and is not supported as a distinct sense in the packet.
The packet does not explicitly support the claim that alpha-mannosidosis is “rare.” It only describes it as “an inborn error of metabolism.”

The packet specifies “lysosomal accumulation of mannose-rich intermediate metabolites,” while the definition says “buildup of mannose-rich substances in cells,” which broadens the location beyond “lysosomal.”

The packet supports that patients have “psychomotor retardation,” but it does not specifically justify framing this as “notable because affected people are described as having psychomotor retardation” in a “psychological or cognitive context.”
